title: High-Plex Whole-Slide Imaging of Human Tissue Using PhenoCycler-Fusion
author: Donovan, Jhaveri, et al.

steps.title: Prepare FFPE slides
steps.instruction: Cut formalin‑fixed paraffin‑embedded tissue sections to 5 µm thickness and place each section in the centre of a charged microscope slide; pre‑heat a dry oven to 60 °C before starting.

steps.title: Prepare staining cocktail and box
steps.instruction: Briefly spin each antibody vial 5 s at 2,350 × g, combine antibodies in Staining Buffer to make the Antibody Cocktail, keep on ice; fill the Slide Staining Box tray with ddH₂O to a depth of 1 cm to create humidity; cut a rectangular piece of parafilm matching the non‑label area of the slide.

steps.title: Apply primary antibody cocktail
steps.instruction: Remove the slide from its Coplin jar of Staining Buffer, gently blot excess buffer with a Kimwipe, place the slide in the Slide Staining Box, dispense 200 µL of Antibody Cocktail onto the top corner of the tissue, ensure complete coverage without bubbles, cover the tissue with the parafilm piece, and close the box lid.

steps.title: Incubate primary antibodies
steps.instruction: Incubate the sealed Slide Staining Box overnight (≈16 h) at 4 °C on a stable, undisturbed surface.

steps.title: Prepare post‑staining fixation buffers
steps.instruction: Arrange Coplin jars in the following order: (a) Staining Buffer (2 min), (b) Staining Buffer (2 min), (c) 1.6 % PFA in Storage Buffer (10 min, freshly prepared within 30 min, under a fume hood), (d) 1× PBS (rinse), (e) 1× PBS (rinse), (f) 1× PBS (rinse), (g) ice‑cold 100 % methanol on ice (5 min), (h) 1× PBS (rinse), (i) 1× PBS (rinse), (j) 1× PBS (rinse). Keep methanol stock frozen until use.

steps.title: Wash slides through fixation series
steps.instruction: Gently lift the parafilm‑covered slide and immerse it 2–3 times in each Coplin jar sequentially (steps a–j), ensuring removal of the Antibody Cocktail and completing all washes.

steps.title: Prepare final fixative solution
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of 1× PBS to an Eppendorf tube for every 5 slides; retrieve one 20 µL aliquot of Fixative Reagent from the –20 °C strip (cut only the needed tubes), melt the aliquot between gloved fingers, spin 5 s at 2,350 × g, then dilute the 20 µL in the 1 mL PBS, vortex to mix.

steps.title: Fix tissue with final fixative
steps.instruction: Place each slide (still on the Slide Staining Box tray) on a Kimwipe to remove excess buffer, add 200 µL of the Final Fixative Solution to the top corner of the tissue (cover fully, avoid bubbles), lay a fresh piece of parafilm over the solution, close the box lid, and incubate 20 min at 22 °C.

steps.title: Final washes and storage
steps.instruction: Arrange Coplin jars as follows: (a) 1× PBS (rinse), (b) 1× PBS (rinse), (c) 1× PBS (rinse), (d) Storage Buffer, (e) 1× PBS (10 min), (f) 1× PhenoCycler Buffer without additive (10 min). Remove the slide from the box, gently discard the parafilm, place the slide in jar (a), lift and immerse 2–3 times, then continue through jars b–f. Slides may be stored in Storage Buffer <5 days at 4 °C; before further processing bring to 22 °C in 1× PBS.

steps.title: Attach Flow Cell to slide
steps.instruction: Lift and immerse the slide 2–3 times in PBS and incubate 10 min; wipe around the tissue with Kimwipes, avoiding prolonged air exposure; open the Flow Cell packet, remove protective plastic, pull the ‘drawer’ from the Flow Cell Assembly Device, place the adhesive‑side‑up Flow Cell in the drawer, position the slide tissue‑side‑down on the Flow Cell (label left), close the drawer, lower the device handle halfway and pause 30 s, then lower fully and hold 2 min, raise the handle, pull out the drawer and remove the assembled Flow Cell‑slide unit, inspect for cracks or misalignment, and submerge the unit in 1× PhenoCycler‑Fusion buffer without additive for 10 min.

steps.title: Optional Flow Cell removal for H&E
steps.instruction: Incubate the Flow Cell‑attached slide in a Coplin jar containing HistoChoice Clearing Agent overnight (≈16 h) at 22 °C; separate the Flow Cell; rinse the slide 2–3 times in each of five ddH₂O jars, then immerse sequentially in three 1× PhenoCycler Buffer (no additive) jars for 10 min each, finally place in PhenoCycler Storage Buffer if not proceeding immediately; proceed with a standard H&E staining protocol.

steps.title: Image on PhenoImager
steps.instruction: Load the prepared slide (with or without Flow Cell) onto the PhenoImager and acquire whole‑slide images according to instrument settings.

steps.title: Quantify images and analyze spatial relationships
steps.instruction: Perform computational analysis using open‑source tools: (1) quality control, (2) cell segmentation, (3) cell phenotyping, (4) spatial analysis; for proximity analysis, use the Scimap spatial_distance function to compute average nearest‑neighbor distances from cells of type B to each cell of type A, store results in adata.uns, and compare across conditions.
